zygomatic_reference.description: Previously checked approximate active right-cheek bundle; its earlier equilibrium is separate from this new layout.

junction.description: Authored lateral fibromuscular junction volume; common geometry interface for layered routes, not a calibrated modiolus.

superficial_oral.description: Superficial route from the junction into upper outer labial tissue; a finite regional continuation, with medial cut unbound.

deep_oral.description: Deeper lower labial continuation, distinct from the superficial upper route; no universal point-insertion assumption.

buccinator_deep.description: Deep transverse/oblique cheek route into the inner perioral layer. Posterior cut is explicit; alveolar/raphe origins are not yet provided.

mandibular_depressor.description: Original continuous DAO-like sheet with finite triangular origin cut directly against the new mandible. Every origin vertex has an exact barycentric bone-surface correspondence; no new dynamics.

scope: Original anatomical construction layout, with explicit source-informed superficial/deep routes and a true geometric mandibular origin footprint. The parts share intended junction space but are not yet a conforming tetrahedral network or force-coupled assembly. No new pose claim.
